<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="blueGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#071B70"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bannerOne" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#747474"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bannerTwo" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="355" fill="url(#blueGradient)"/>
  <path d="M0 320 C75 285 135 345 205 315 C280 283 328 315 390 286 L390 390 L0 390 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  <path d="M0 355 C92 325 147 374 224 345 C296 318 345 345 390 326 L390 425 L0 425 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="18" y="22" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="332" y1="18" x2="338" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="18" x2="332" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="16" x2="347" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="16" x2="341" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="14" x2="356" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="14" x2="350" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="366" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="369" y1="20" x2="372" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="376" y="12" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="378" y="14" width="9" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="35" cy="62" r="16" fill="#000000" filter="url(#shadow)" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="60" r="15" fill="#000000"/>
    <polyline points="40,53 32,60 40,67" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="63" y="66" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Promotions</text>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="103" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.86">Make your next movie night more rewarding</text>

  <!-- first promotional banner shadow/card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="119" width="352" height="132" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="19" y="115" width="352" height="132" rx="13" fill="url(#bannerOne)"/>
    <path d="M245 115 L371 115 L371 247 L302 247 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.38"/>
    <path d="M257 247 L337 115 L371 115 L371 247 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="151" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
    <polygon points="286,207 316,172 336,193 350,180 371,207" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="158" r="7" fill="#E0E0E0" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="37" y="145" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">WEEKDAY SPECIAL</text>
    <text x="37" y="173" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">20% OFF</text>
    <text x="37" y="194" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Your Tuesday movie ticket</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="37" y="210" width="105" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="89" y="227" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">USE OFFER</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- second promotional banner -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="267" width="352" height="132" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="19" y="263" width="352" height="132" rx="13" fill="url(#bannerTwo)"/>
    <path d="M246 263 L371 263 L371 395 L290 395 Z" fill="#143CC9" opacity="0.72"/>
    <path d="M275 395 L348 263 L371 263 L371 395 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.11"/>
    <polygon points="278,355 303,320 322,340 338,307 371,355" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.38"/>
    <circle cx="332" cy="300" r="8" fill="#E0E0E0" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="37" y="293" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">COMBO OFFER</text>
    <text x="37" y="321" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">FREE POPCORN</text>
    <text x="37" y="342" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">With any large drink</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="37" y="358" width="105" height="25" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="89" y="375" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">VIEW DETAILS</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- offer details sheet -->
  <rect x="0" y="414" width="390" height="430" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="447" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Offer details</text>
  <rect x="20" y="461" width="350" height="1" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <circle cx="31" cy="488" r="4" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="45" y="493" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Save 20% on standard movie tickets every Tuesday.</text>
  <circle cx="31" cy="518" r="4" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="45" y="523" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Add a large drink and receive one free popcorn.</text>
  <circle cx="31" cy="548" r="4" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="45" y="553" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Offers apply to selected sessions and locations.</text>

  <text x="20" y="592" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Terms and conditions</text>
  <text x="20" y="616" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Valid until 31 August 2025. One offer per transaction.</text>
  <text x="20" y="634" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Cannot be combined with other discounts or promotions.</text>
  <text x="20" y="652" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Not redeemable for cash. Availability may vary by cinema.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="677" width="350" height="50" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="20" y="673" width="350" height="50" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">RESERVE A SERVICE</text>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="758" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Your offers</text>
  <text x="20" y="779" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Offers are automatically applied at checkout when eligible.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="798" width="390" height="46" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="798" x2="390" y2="798" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="35,812 44,805 53,812 53,821 47,821 47,815 41,815 41,821 35,821" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <text x="44" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#143CC9">HOME</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="130" cy="812" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="817" x2="141" y2="823" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="130" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">MOVIES</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="212" y="805" width="15" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="215" y1="802" x2="215" y2="808" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="802" x2="224" y2="808" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="220" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">TICKETS</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="315" cy="808" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="315" cy="818" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="315" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
</svg>
